models.name: DALL-E 2

models.description: SDXL 1.0 base model by Stability AI with improved image quality at higher resolutions.

models.description: Latent text-to-image diffusion model by Runway, fine-tuned from SD 1.4.

models.description: SD fine-tune for anime-style image generation.

models.description: SD 1.5 fine-tune optimized for artistic outputs.

models.description: Open-source model by Playground AI focused on aesthetic quality.

models.name: DeepFloyd IF
models.description: Pixel-space diffusion model by DeepFloyd (Stability AI).

models.name: IDEFICS-9B-Instruct
models.description: 9B-parameter open multimodal model by HuggingFace, instruction-tuned.

models.name: Kandinsky 2.2
models.description: Multilingual text-to-image model by Sber AI.

models.name: InternViT-6B-448px-V1-5
models.description: 6B-parameter vision transformer by OpenGVLab, V1.5 release.

models.name: InternViT-300M-448px

models.name: InternViT-6B-224px
models.description: 6B-parameter vision transformer by OpenGVLab at 224px resolution.

models.name: EVA-CLIP-18B
models.description: 18B-parameter CLIP model by BAAI, largest open CLIP model.

models.name: InternViT-6B-448px-V1-2
models.description: 6B-parameter vision transformer by OpenGVLab, V1.2 release.

models.name: EVA-CLIP-8B-448
models.description: 8B-parameter CLIP model by BAAI at 448px resolution.

models.name: InternViT-6B-448px-V1-0
models.description: 6B-parameter vision transformer by OpenGVLab, V1.0 release.

models.description: Multimodal model by Infi-MM based on Zephyr architecture.

models.name: MLCD ViT-Large-336
models.description: Multi-label contrastive distillation ViT-Large by DeepGlint.
